title: Rework snooze UI
body:
Currently the "Snooze" feature is missing some really handy features.

For me most of the time it only seems to show the status of any alerts that have already been snoozed, what would be better if it shows all of the alerts that have been setup and whether they have been snoozed and if snoozed how long is left on the snooze.

This would also allow you to pre-snooze without having to go all the way deep into the settings menu.


```
---------------------------------------
|Low Alerts                            |
| * Low - Snoozed :  58 minutes left   |
| * Lower - Active                     |
| * Emergency Low - Active             |
|                                      |
|High Alerts                           |
| * High - Active                      |
| * Higher - Active                    |
|------------------------------------- |
| Hold to pre-snooze                   |
|------------------------------------- |
| Suspend high alerts                  |
| Suspend low alerts                   |
| Suspend all alerts                   |
---------------------------------------
```

comments.body:
@danpowell88 Would you please explain this request?
I hardly ever tap on the "Snooze Alert" menu option.
When an alarm triggers, I snooze it from the Android notification panel, which I access by just pulling down from the top of the screen.

Can you explain why you go to the snooze panel and why you need to see all your alarms?
I mean at any point in time, you cannot be concerned both about having a low and having a high, can you?  So, I don't understand the need to be able to see all your alarms.

Can you help me see this from your perspective?

Thanks
I am closing this for now until there is more detail about the request.
